title: Verdict and Ledger
author: Jonah Sandoval
blurb: Hazel Crane, a true-crime podcaster chasing the coldest case on record, has spent five years keeping the town's secrets filed and alphabetized. Then the town's beloved founder is exhumed and the coffin is empty — and they are pulled straight into the middle of it. Now they must untangle alibis woven thirty years ago, and time is already running out.
style: atmospheric and lyrical, with strong sensory detail
